title: Setup → Authentication: controls that contradict the system — self-service registration ON while the audience is invitation only; Google login ON with no client id or secret
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, the maintainer's browser pass of 2026-10-20. Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-27** of track 2 (Setup as the system administrator), by the cloud tester `session_01VuXyJvhGKJy8qeUvhKyxzv`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `f22dfa52` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.5, in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-setup-pass-2026-10-20` at `ed4f40e42`, which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes it.

## The finding, as measured

- **Actual:**
  - *Allow self-service registration* is ON, yet *Self-registration audience* is "Invitation only". `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-up/email` → 403 `SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED`; `/register` says self-registration is not open.
  - *Enable Google login* is ON while its required *Google client ID\** and *secret\** are empty; the login page shows no Google button.
- **Evidence:** [`26-config-auth-full.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/26-config-auth-full.png), [`26-config-auth.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/26-config-auth.png).
- **class: a.** **Reach:** every deployment.
- **Suspected landing:** objectstack `plugin-auth` settings manifest (auth namespace defaults / dependent-field rules).
- **Dedupe words:** self-service registration toggle invite_only, google login enabled without client id.

## Seat review

- **Landing (seat review):** `service-settings` `auth.manifest.ts`: the namespace defaults and the dependent-field rules.

## Dedupe

Method: semantic `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack and objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed, using the finding's own dedupe words and a second phrasing; plus a grep of every issue title (objectstack #1–#24751, objectui #7–#13153) listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint, because the semantic search can miss title words (objectstack#14743).
- 1 hit in objectstack, 1 in objectui. The nearest is objectui#11691 (sign-up offered under `invite_only`, closed). **New.**
